# Find Skills

Search and manage Claude Code skills from the skills.sh marketplace.

## Commands

- `npx skills find <query>` — search for skills
- `npx skills add <owner>/<repo> --skill <name> -g -a claude-code` — install a skill
- `npx skills list -g --json` — list installed skills  
- `npx skills update -g -y` — update all installed skills

## Examples

Find skills for testing:
```bash
npx skills find testing
npx skills find tdd
```

Install a specific skill:
```bash
npx skills add vercel-labs/skills --skill find-skills -g -a claude-code -y
```
